squad.name: SDLC Maintenance
squad.description: Changes an existing product: triages a bug, feature, optimization, or upgrade, routes it, verifies it, and reports.

roles.name: SDLC Lead
roles.description: Leads SDLC squads: delegates, verifies evidence, and reports.

roles.name: SDLC Product Analyst
roles.description: Turns requests and sources into briefs, PRDs, epics, and stories.
roles.role: Briefs, PRD, epics and stories, requirement changes, build queue

roles.name: SDLC UX Designer
roles.description: Designs screens, states, and the design system for the requirements.

roles.name: SDLC Architect
roles.description: Designs the simplest system that fits, records decisions, and analyses impact.

roles.name: SDLC Developer
roles.description: Builds stories end to end and verifies them on the running app.
roles.role: Implementation of epics, stories, and features

roles.name: SDLC Bug Fixer
roles.description: Reproduces a defect and fixes it with the smallest change.
roles.role: Defects and small changes in one component

roles.name: SDLC Code Reviewer
roles.description: Independent review of changes and plans, with a verdict first.

roles.name: SDLC QA Tester
roles.description: Designs tests from acceptance criteria and runs them on the real system.

roles.name: SDLC Security Reviewer
roles.description: Gates a change or release on verified security controls.
roles.role: Security review of changes and of the whole product

roles.name: SDLC DevOps
roles.description: Packages and releases one verified digest; production needs approval.

charter.mission: Keep an existing product correct, safe and current: fix bugs, ship changes, and keep it up to date.

responsibilities.text: Triage each bug or change: type, risk tier, and the route it takes.
Deliver the change through review and QA, with evidence for each claim.
Keep dependencies, the build and the documentation current.

charter.boundaries: No production deploys and no deletions without the boss. Spending money needs the boss.
charter.escalation: A blocked request or an open decision goes to the requester, named on the request.
charter.intake: Bugs and changes arrive as issues assigned to this squad.
